page.layout: One printed page, badly stained and faded. A large display heading runs across the top, with two or three smaller lines of faint type beneath it. Nothing legible in the margins.
page.notes: The page is so heavily stained, faded and shadowed by show-through that the printed words cannot be read. The large capitals across the top are visible as a heading but their letters are not certain, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The mark at the right edge (a small "o" with a vertical rule) and the pen strokes and tears are not printed text and are left out. No page number, running head, catchword or signature can be made out.
